requirements.Q1: All eleven source/browser camera pairs inspected, including ordinary entry, reading, seated use and close-ups. The former dark/red timber and detached-looking wall/window joins are corrected.
requirements.Q2: Each book, restraint, fixture and furniture assembly retains object/part identity; batch membership maps back to source parts.
requirements.Q3: Declared part contacts, shelf bearing, lateral book restraint and world geometry are measured. Rear shelf ledgers carry the denser library. Masonry is a closed exact union with conserved volume and original constituent evidence.
requirements.Q4: Owner claim/release, seated movement lock and standing movement are exercised against server state and another participant. The workspace board displays an actual note. Books and door operation remain physically plausible deferred uses.
requirements.Q5: The current geometry passes the unchanged reach, knee, route, spawn and display-ray checks. Actual seated camera and post-release floor position are recorded.
requirements.Q6: The cleared photographic Cannon exterior is retained and inspected in near-window and seated views; frame, sill and reveals read as one installation.
requirements.Q7: Warm Modern Meeting 0.3.3 quality level and later shared feedback are retained; 0.4.0 is historical rejected/rework evidence rather than the target.
requirements.Q8: 149 reference volumes form four supported runs. Neighbours touch, the case side and a clamped bookend retain each run, retrieval headroom remains, and related formats vary as series rather than isolated display props. The shelf group was compared with real-use photographs.

corrections: Replaced 120 mm isolated-book pitch with measured contiguous runs and readable project-authored bindings.
Added rear shelf load paths and corrected bookend/clamp and spine/board interfaces.
Combined paper/binding texture regions without removing book parts, reducing actual shipping primitives below 250.
Revised the source timber finish consistently in both renderers rather than overriding runtime colors.
Removed plaster T-junction raster cracks by joining the enclosure before lightmap generation; verified closed topology and union volume.
Preserved Float32 positions, normals and UVs through lossless Meshopt encoding and checked decoded attributes.
renderingDifferences: Cycles area-light reflections and the runtime room environment differ on metal and grazing timber; the corresponding finish, grain scale, shapes and material distinctions remain recognizable.
The baked browser view retains stronger fine book-edge/contact contrast than the path-traced source.
limits: No human visual acceptance is inferred.
Saved-source export repeatability is not a fresh-author/fresh-bake proof.
Public exact-commit staging observations are recorded separately after publication.
